name: Toggle Text Widget for Elementor
author: Gazi Mohammad Yeasin

sections.description:
Toggle Text Widget for Elementor is a lightweight tool that lets you show a short summary text with additional hidden content that users can toggle with a button like Read More / Show Less.

This is useful when you want to keep your page clean while still providing additional details for users who want to read more. The widget integrates seamlessly with Elementor and works with any layout.

🎬 Live Demo: https://crazycafe.net/demo/elementor-toggle-text/

Features

  • Simple and lightweight Elementor widget
  • Show summary text with expandable hidden content
  • Toggle button (Read More / Show Less)
  • Fully responsive
  • Easy to use inside Elementor editor
  • Clean and minimal design
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/toggle-text-widget-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor editor.
  4. Search for Toggle Text widget.
  5. Drag and drop it into your page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. This plugin requires the Elementor page builder to be installed and activated.

Can I customize the text?

Yes. You can customize the summary text and the hidden content directly from the Elementor widget settings.

Will it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. The plugin works with any theme that supports Elementor.
